Williamsburg large 2 Bedroom / 2 Bathroom (entire home, $539/night, max 5 guests)

constraint_judgments.evidence: The itinerary lists March 4, March 5, and March 6, 2022.
The booked listing's maximum occupancy is 3, although the itinerary text claims max 5 guests.
constraint_judgments.note: The record capacity is below four travelers.

constraint_judgments.evidence: There are two attractions listed on each date, but the March 5 pair is Museum of Fine Arts, Boston and Faneuil Hall Marketplace, and the March 6 pair is Boston Tea Party Ships & Museum and View Boston. The activity requirements also call for nearby attractions and regular seated breaks; no breaks are listed.
constraint_judgments.note: The daily attraction count is two, but the plan does not meet all of the activity requirements.

constraint_judgments.evidence: Red Mesa Restaurant has Aggregate Rating 4.5 on March 4 and 5; Club Cubana has Aggregate Rating 4.4 on March 6.
constraint_judgments.note: Each day includes a restaurant meal rated at least 4.0.

constraint_judgments.evidence: The Williamsburg large 2 Bedroom / 2 Bathroom record lists room type Entire home/apt.
constraint_judgments.note: The booked listing is an entire home/apartment.

constraint_judgments.evidence: The same listing is used on both accommodation days, but its recorded maximum occupancy is 3.
constraint_judgments.note: It is one property, but it cannot host all four travelers according to the record.

constraint_judgments.evidence: The lunches are described only as “Simple/quick meal” and have no matching restaurant record or recorded cost.
constraint_judgments.note: The plan supplies no record-based evidence that these meals are inexpensive.

constraint_judgments.evidence: The recorded restaurant cuisines include Tea, Cafe, Bakery, Fast Food, Indian, Seafood, Desserts, BBQ, and Mediterranean; none of the selected restaurants is recorded as French or American.
constraint_judgments.note: The selected restaurant meals do not provide the requested French and American cuisines.
